subtitle: Zungeza amapayipi uxhume
short_description: Phendula amapayipi ukuze amanzi ageleze kusukela ekuqaleni kuya ekupheleni.
description:
Zungeza amathayili amapayipi ayisishiyagalolunye ebhodini le-3×3 ukuze akhe umzila owodwa oqhubekayo, ongavuzi, ukusuka kwelinye iphethelo kuya kwelinye.

Thepha ithayili ukuze uliphendule. Amajika namathayili okuphela anezindawo ezine, kanti amapayipi aqondile anezimbili.

Amabhodi amasha ayisithupha, lilinye ngalinye livula elilandelayo lapho selixazululiwe. Ukuhlehlisa nokuqala kabusha kuhlala kutholakala, akukho sibali-sikhathi, futhi inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi. Idlala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ayikho izikhangiso, akukho i-akhawunti, akukho ukuqoqwa kwedatha.
